# kay

> kay is a Bun web framework. A `.kay` file is one component: TypeScript fences, then a pug-like indented template. Pages render to plain HTML strings on the server, islands run on kay's own signals and DOM runtime, and an Elysia plugin serves it all with automatic islands. Everything is typed, templates included, and `kay check` reports errors at the `.kay` line and column.

## Rules that are easy to get wrong

- Every dynamic value sits in `{}`: `a(href={url})`, `p Hello {name}`. A static attribute value is a quoted string: `a(href="/about")`.
- A signal or memo is read by calling it, `count()`, in the template as in the script; one the template names bare where its value goes is an error, `uncalled-signal`, which `kay check --fix` calls. It is written by assigning it, in both: `count = 0`, `count += step`, `count++` and `open = !open()` compile to `.set`, and `count.set(c => c * 2)` still works; assigning works on any signal a `const`, an import or a prop typed `Signal<T>` from `kay` holds, wherever it was made, and one in a `let` or a property takes `.set`. Handed on whole, `Toggle(open={open})`, `bind:value={query}` or a function's argument, it passes the signal itself, for a prop typed `Signal<T>`. Props and server data are plain names: `{title}`, not `{title()}`.
- A `for` matches its rows across renders by `item.id`, else by the item itself, so a list of objects with no `id`, made afresh on each render, names a key: `for post of posts key={post.slug}`; `kay check` warns of such a list in an island (`identity-key`).
- An `await` block streams any promise it is given, `await comments`, `await data.comments`, a prop or one a component makes; a rejection before it renders crashes nothing, and `defer()` is no longer needed.
- The component script exports types only. Shared values live in `.ts` modules.
- A page has no props: its data comes from its `--- server` fence.
- `window`, `document`, `localStorage` and the other globals only a browser has are read in `effect` or `onMount`, or in a component whose script fence is `--- client`; reading one while rendering throws on the server.
- Durations kay's config and server code take are seconds as a number, or a number with its unit as a string, `'30s'`, `'5m'`, `'1.5h'`, `'30d'` or `'2w'` (type `Duration` from `kay`): `cached`'s `ttl`, `revalidate`, a session's `maxAge`, `rateLimit`'s `window`, an action's `minTime` and `shutdownTimeout`. Each must be positive, which `kay check` reports for a literal `cached` ttl and the server for the rest. Only `kay/test`'s browser `timeout` is in milliseconds, as `bun:test`'s own timeouts are; a store's `set(id, data, maxAge)` gets seconds.
- Indentation is spaces only, consistent within a block. Text after a tag needs one space: `p Hello`, never `p:Hello`.
- Under `kay dev`, `.kay/dev/errors.json` lists the errors the server met, a compile error at its `.kay` line, a request that threw with its stack on `.kay` lines, or an island's error in the browser: read it rather than opening the browser.
- Pug features that do not exist: `- code` lines, `#{}` and `!{}` interpolation, `+mixins`, `include`, `extends`, `block`, filters, `&attributes`, `case`, `each`, `while`, `unless`, `doctype`; a line starting with one is reported, with what kay writes instead.

## Docs

To build a site, read [Build a site](llms/site.md) first: one page walking through config, layout, content pages, islands and a form, enough to write them. The topic files below are references for what it leaves out: open one when a task needs something the walkthrough does not show. Each opens with its common tasks, one sentence and one complete example apiece, which answer most tasks; the exact rules follow under Reference, one per bullet, to search for an edge case rather than read whole.

- [Build a site](llms/site.md): one walkthrough of a small site: config and page titles, the layout and its nav, a Markdown collection and its pages, the 404 page, islands and shared state, a form checked on the server and in the browser
- [Components](llms/components.md): the fences of a `.kay` file, props, signals, memos, effects, generic components, `import.meta.glob`, and shipping components in a package
- [Template lines](llms/templates.md): the indented template syntax: elements, classes, attributes, events, bindings, `if`/`for`/`await`/`try` blocks, slots
- [Head and site metadata](llms/head.md): `head` in templates, site-wide SEO defaults and social cards, sitemap and robots.txt, favicon and web manifest, offline service worker, site search, self-hosted fonts
- [Styles and assets](llms/styles-and-assets.md): component styles and Tailwind, `public/`, imported images, fonts and files, wasm and workers, responsive images, Iconify icons
- [Islands and navigation](llms/islands.md): what runs in the browser: islands, shared and persisted state, transitions, error fallbacks, context, unique ids, browser-only components, in-place page navigation, and `.kay` components on a page kay does not serve
- [Pages and routing](llms/routing.md): file-based routes, params, layouts, the server fence and `ctx`, endpoint files (`llms.txt.ts` exporting `GET`), prerendering and server islands, redirects, rewrites, base path, static export
- [Content collections](llms/content.md): Markdown, JSON and YAML collections read against a schema, loaders for a CMS or a database, preview mode for drafts
- [Locales](llms/locales.md): i18n: locale prefixes, typed messages, number and date formatting, redirecting a visitor to their locale
- [Caching and streaming](llms/rendering.md): caching rendered pages and data, streaming deferred values with `await` blocks, `renderToString` for mails and feeds
- [Actions](llms/actions.md): form posts that work without JavaScript and calls from islands, typed by a schema: validation errors, files, redirects, rate limits
- [Stored files](llms/files.md): `files` keeps uploads on disk or in an S3 bucket, links them from pages, resizes stored images, signs links to private files, and islands read upload progress
- [Locals, sessions and guards](llms/server.md): per-request `ctx.locals`, cookie sessions and their stores, a typed `defineEnv`, `_guard.ts` route guards
- [API routes](llms/api-routes.md): Elysia modules under `src/api/`, server-sent events, websockets and rooms, reading them typed from islands, and `live()` values every open page follows
- [Testing](llms/testing.md): `kay/test`: rendering pages and posting actions in `bun test`, browser tests
- [Checks and lints](llms/checks.md): what `kay check` reports, every lint at its default level and how to change it, ESLint on `.kay` files
- [Project setup and commands](llms/project.md): `kay.config.ts`, tsconfig, editor setup, every `kay` CLI command and template, and `kay render <url>`, printing what a page renders without starting a server, and `kay mcp`, serving kay's tools and these guides to an agent
- [Running in production](llms/production.md): request logs, tracing and Server-Timing, health checks and graceful shutdown, cron and background jobs, running behind a proxy, security headers and CSP, compression
- [Upgrading](llms/upgrading.md): what each minor release of kay and its libraries breaks, and what an app changes to move to it
- [What's new](llms/whats-new.md): what each release adds, newest first, each feature with the doc covering it
- [Privacy and personal data](llms/privacy.md): the cookies and data kay keeps and for how long, erasing a person, consent-gated analytics, photo metadata
